literal_meaning: হাত ধোয়া বা হাত পরিষ্কার করা
figurative_meaning_en: Sleight of hand; dexterity or skill of the hands
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার হাতসাফাই দেখলে মনে হয় যেন জাদুকর।
শিল্পীর হাতসাফাই তার কাজকে অসাধারণ করে তুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His sleight of hand makes him seem like a magician.
The artist's dexterity with his hands makes his work extraordinary.
note: This idiom often refers to skillful manipulation or expertise in hand-related tasks, common in everyday Bengali expressions.
